summary: Iteration 3 backend-only verification of the 4 fixes + full iteration-2 regression suite against the public preview URL. Extended /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py from 42 to 45 tests (added: email-keyed brute-force lockout against the REAL admin email, PDF/bilancio/send-email resilience to a corrupt base64 logo+signature, numero_riutilizzabile bool coercion when the year counter doc is missing) and added a session autouse fixture that clears db.login_attempts before/after the run (mandatory now that lockout is email-keyed). Also validated the startup backfill migration by inserting a legacy tipi_pacchetto doc without esclude_da_compensi, restarting the backend, and confirming the field was backfilled to false. RESULT: 45/45 passed, twice consecutively (no flakes). All 4 iteration-3 fixes are confirmed working; the 2 previously-failing tests now pass.

minor.issue: Cannot clear a stored image/field: update_org filters out None (`if v is not None`), so logo_base64 / president_signature_base64 can never be reset to null via the API. After uploading a corrupt logo an admin has no way to remove it from the UI - the only recovery is a direct DB update. Same pattern in PATCH /tesserati, /tipi-pacchetto, /movimenti. Use model_dump(exclude_unset=True) without the None filter (or an explicit clearable-fields list).

Still no cascade (unchanged from iteration 2). Confirmed empirically: 9 orphan ricevute (+ their movimenti) referencing already-deleted tesserati were found in the DB and had to be cleaned manually. Orphan ricevute keep polluting /api/movimenti and the bilancio totals. Same for lezioni.partecipanti[] pointing at deleted abbonamenti.

Minor hardening notes on the now-working lockout: (1) no TTL index on db.login_attempts, documents accumulate forever; (2) lockout is keyed on email only, so an attacker can lock out a legitimate user (account-enumeration/DoS) - consider also counting on X-Forwarded-For first hop; (3) locked_until is not reset/extended when it expires, count stays >=5 so the very first wrong attempt after the window re-locks immediately for 15 more minutes.

No unique index on ricevute.numero/anno+seq. Number reuse after DELETE is intentional, but a concurrent create + delete can produce two receipts with the same numero. Add a unique index on (anno, seq).
App-level CORS correctly echoes the explicit origin with allow-credentials on port 8001, but the k8s ingress rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to '*' on the public URL. Not an app bug.

action_items: Allow explicitly clearing nullable fields in PATCH /organizzazione (and the other PATCH endpoints) - a corrupt logo/signature currently cannot be removed from the UI
Add cascade cleanup on DELETE /tesserati and /abbonamenti (ricevute, movimenti, lezioni.partecipanti) - orphans confirmed in the DB
Add a TTL index on db.login_attempts and reset count when locked_until expires
critical_code_review_comments: Fix 1 verified: login keys the counter on email only; 6 wrong passwords on admin@wolfsmind.it -> 429 at attempt 5/6, subsequent attempts (including the CORRECT password) also 429, and clearing db.login_attempts restores a 200 login.

Fix 2 verified: pdf_utils._image_from_b64 now runs PIL Image.open(...).verify() before building RLImage; with logo_base64=president_signature_base64='data:image/png;base64,notarealimage' the receipt PDF, bilancio PDF and send-email all return 200 (%PDF magic bytes present) and no 'broken data stream' traceback appears in backend logs after the restart.

Fix 3 verified: startup backfill ($set esclude_da_compensi:false where $exists:false) migrated a hand-inserted legacy doc after supervisor restart; count of tipi_pacchetto missing the field is now 0 and GET /api/tipi-pacchetto returns the key on every doc.
Fix 4 verified: DELETE /api/ricevute returns numero_riutilizzabile as a real bool - False (not null) when the ricevute_<year> counter document is absent.
@app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is still deprecated - migrate to the lifespan context manager.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run serially: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -q -n 0 (pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; -n 0 avoids receipt-numbering races across classes - do NOT edit pytest.ini). All 45 tests pass. Lockout is now EMAIL-keyed, so a stale db.login_attempts doc for admin@wolfsmind.it will break every test - the autouse session fixture _reset_lockout clears the collection before/after the run; keep it. tests/legacy_seed.py seed|cleanup inserts/removes a legacy tipi_pacchetto doc to re-validate the startup backfill (requires a `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`). If PDF tests 500, check organizzazione.logo_base64/president_signature_base64 - PATCH cannot set them back to null (None filter), reset with a direct mongo update. Frontend has never been tested.
rca_of_the_issue: All four iteration-2 root causes are addressed: (a) the lockout counter no longer includes request.client.host, which behind the k8s ingress varied per request and split the counter across documents; (b) reportlab decodes images lazily at doc.build(), so _image_from_b64 now eagerly calls PIL Image.verify() and returns None for undecodable payloads, degrading gracefully; (c) legacy tipi_pacchetto docs are backfilled at startup instead of relying on the Pydantic default; (d) the truthiness expression `counter and counter.get('seq')==seq` is now wrapped in bool().
